name: PubMed Central and NCBI E-utilities
license: Each article's own licence; Open Access subset reusable (PMC copyright page)
robots: pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/robots.txt (read): User-agent: * Crawl-delay: 1, Disallow: /; no AI group. So the PMC web pages are closed to scripts; the services below are the way in

rate_limit: 3 requests a second; large jobs at weekends or 9 pm to 5 am Eastern
notes: PMC copyright page and NCBI scripting guidelines read. Scripts use E-utilities (3 requests a second, tool and email parameters; we send a descriptive User-Agent), the OAI-PMH service and the ID converter, not the web pages. PMC full text is read only for the Open Access subset, each article under its own licence. No key is needed.
